problem: Technical SEO is strong, but organic growth was not explicitly optimizing money pages for qualified orders and revenue.

evidence.dataforseo_rank_set: No measurable ranked-keyword set returned for bedrijfsgeheugen.nl in the NL dataset at audit time.

decision: Extend the existing canonical SEO Growth Intelligence rather than create a parallel SEO system.
prevention: Do not optimize raw traffic without a conversion hypothesis.
Prefer updating the canonical money page over creating another page for the same intent.
Never use doorway pages, scaled thin content, keyword stuffing, link schemes, cloaking or unsupported social proof.
Limit autonomous daily changes to three reversible evidence-gated changes.
Require production readback and downstream CTA/lead/order/revenue measurement before promoting the learning to PROVEN.
Keep the canonical system map, skill projection, Brain learning, human documentation and regression test synchronized in the same delivery lineage.
Keep one explicit low-friction primary CTA across priority money pages and route generic contact intent through the canonical qualification path unless evidence shows a better order outcome.
For generated website routes, enforce CRO/SEO contracts after the final generator/normalizer stage and fail the build on drift; editing readable source HTML alone is not terminal.
Behavioral landing-page optimization must remain part of the existing SEO Conversion-to-Orders + Growth Swarm + Persuasion Revenue stack; never create a parallel CRO authority.
Optimize behavioral variants by realized revenue and paid orders before weaker micro-metrics whenever terminal outcomes are available.
Rollback on material trust, accessibility, mobile-readability or qualified-conversion regression.
Never use fake scarcity, fake urgency, fake social proof, hidden costs, confirmshaming or preselected consent.
Require every future chat/agent touching commercial website copy to inherit the repository-native order-first contract, including same-lineage static-i18n and final-build production proof.
root_cause: Technical SEO was healthy, but autonomous SEO selection did not explicitly combine commercial search intent, conversion friction and expected order value before choosing money-page changes.
prevention_rule: Optimize existing canonical money pages for qualified-order outcomes before creating new content; prioritize evidence-backed intent and conversion gaps, cap each daily cycle at three reversible changes, and require measured downstream outcomes before promoting a pattern.
conversion_path: free Frisse Blik 30 min -> evidence/fit -> paid Scan or scoped implementation -> outcome learning
root_cause_build_authority: V18 build regeneration can overwrite readable repository HTML for generated pages such as homepage and product, so conversion rules must also be enforced on the final build artifact.
